events.description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-07, while answering "what is GB-320": `storypole show` printed every field but the description, so the answer required reading the ledger with `list --json` and a python filter. It happened twice in two turns. The fix renders the description with paragraph breaks preserved and prints nothing for an empty one (commit 77844a1, 3 tests).

PROCESS NOTE, recorded because it caused this ticket to exist in the first place: filed title-only via `storypole defer` without --desc, even though the flag exists. Several tickets from this session carry a title and no evidence.
